episodes.synopsis: A pact with a Z/X known as Rigel saves Azumi’s life. Finally able to live as a normal girl, Azumi starts a new year at an academy for humans and their Z/X partners.
episodes.title: Blossom Adorned Campus

episodes.synopsis: Chaos reigns as the onslaught against the academy continues. How can the new students withstand such strong enemy attacks?
episodes.title: Drive Shaft Ignition!

episodes.synopsis: The students learn the truth behind the attack on the academy. The realms all face an existential threat and the time has come to unite against a common foe.
episodes.title: Branded E

episodes.synopsis: The Rank E Team undergoes training from Hell, and the instructor’s methods may end up pushing the team too far...
episodes.title: The Guardian and the Guarded

episodes.synopsis: The Rank E and D Teams face off in a mock battle. But when Matoi panics and unleashes her power, her teammates find themselves caught in the crossfire.
episodes.title: Overboost

episodes.synopsis: Mastering Overboost is the key to moving up the rankings. Unfortunately, Yuni reaches her breaking point because of the training and goes AWOL.
episodes.title: Slacker Z/X

episodes.synopsis: Finals are here and the Rank E Team faces expulsion if they don’t pass. So, how is it fair that they’re going up against the Rank A Team first?
episodes.title: Vow to the Blue Skies

episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation is here at last, but that doesn’t mean the team can rest on their laurels.
episodes.title: Summer Vacation

episodes.synopsis: It’s time to say goodbye to the Student Council since its members are transferring overseas. Azumi wants to do something special and plans a farewell party for them.
episodes.title: Never Say Goodbye?

episodes.synopsis: The Rank E team learns of the true enemy and why the realms have banded together.
episodes.title: Inerma & Dunamis

episodes.synopsis: Betrayal cripples the academy’s combat capabilities. With reinforcements not coming, the Rank E Team must either fight or retreat.
episodes.title: Fabricated Life

episodes.synopsis: Will friendship be enough to win the day when the divine is an enemy?
episodes.title: Code Reunion
